about: The rules picker's topics. A post gets the first topic whose rules match, in this order (market topics first), else other. A rule is a word or phrase matched case-insensitively on word boundaries in the post's words (links removed); a trailing * matches any ending. A post matching any 'none' phrase skips that topic. 'names': the topic also matches when the post names a counted instrument. Drafted from 400 posts read on 2 Oct 2026; part of the rules version (rules.json).

topics.name: Trade and tariffs
topics.description: Tariffs, trade deals and talks, trade deficits, imports and exports, export controls.

topics.name: The Fed and interest rates
topics.description: The Federal Reserve, its chair, rate cuts, mortgage rates and bond yields.

topics.name: Crypto
topics.description: Bitcoin, ether, stablecoins, crypto policy and meme coins.

topics.name: Energy and oil
topics.description: Oil, gas and gasoline prices, drilling, pipelines, LNG, coal, wind, power plants and shipping lanes for energy.

topics.name: Taxes, spending and debt
topics.description: Tax cuts and rises, the budget bills, spending, the debt ceiling, shutdowns and payments to the public.

topics.name: The economy and markets
topics.description: The stock market, jobs numbers, inflation and prices, growth, recession and the housing market.

topics.name: Companies, industries and deals
topics.description: Named companies and their products, investments and factories, deals, industries (chips, steel, autos, drugs, defense, banks).

topics.name: War, peace and sanctions
topics.description: Wars and military action, ceasefires and peace deals, sanctions, nuclear programs, hostages abroad.

topics.name: Elections and campaigns
topics.description: Elections, voting and ballots, polls, primaries, endorsements, rallies and the campaign.

topics.name: Courts and investigations
topics.description: Judges and courts, prosecutions and trials, the DOJ and FBI, lawsuits, impeachment, investigations.

topics.name: Border, immigration and crime
topics.description: The border, illegal immigration and deportations, ICE, cartels and drugs, crime and policing.

topics.name: The media
topics.description: News outlets and their reporters, ratings and interviews.

topics.name: Other
topics.description: Anything else: thanks, appointments, personal news, culture, sports.
